title: Email Receipt & Ingestion
descriptionItems: Orchestrator Agent monitors dedicated inbox via Microsoft Graph API.
New email with attachment(s) detected.
Email metadata (From, Subject, Date, Vendor Email) captured.
Unique Global Service Invoice ID generated (SERV-INV-20260511-784512).
Email archived and forwarded to Service PO Extractor Agent.

title: Extraction
descriptionItems: Extractor Agent receives raw email and attachment.
Document Processing: determine file type, apply OCR + AI Document Intelligence.
Key data extracted: Vendor Name/Code, Invoice Number & Date, PO Number, SES Number, line items, tax details, etc.
Service-specific extraction: identifies Item Category ‘D’ references or Resource lines.
Output: structured JSON payload with extracted data.

title: Compliance Checks
descriptionItems: Translator Agent normalizes data: language translation, currency & UoM conversion, tax code standardisation.
Compliance Checker performs layered validations: Vendor validation (via Master Data Agent), regulatory/policy compliance, document completeness, duplicate check.

title: Validation
descriptionItems: Orchestrator identifies target ERP (SAP or BC) based on Company Code/PO prefix.
For SAP: retrieves PO (ME23N), verifies Item Cat D, checks SES status (ML81N) must be Accepted. Compares quantities/amounts between Invoice, SES and PO.
For D365 BC: retrieves PO, checks Posted Purchase Receipt. Compares Qty to Invoice vs Qty Received, Unit Cost and Line Amounts.
Tolerance check: applies configured tolerances (OMR6 for SAP, Purchases Setup for BC).

title: Posting
descriptionItems: Posting Agent receives approved payload.
Final enrichment: latest account assignments, correct tax codes and G/L accounts.
SAP: BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE / MIRO background, updates PO history.
BC: Create Purchase Invoice via API, posts document, updates Vendor Ledger Entry.
Post-posting: vendor open item created, confirmation email, audit log update, triggers payment proposal run.
Orchestrator marks Global Service Invoice ID as ‘Completed’.
